exclude.HIDED: Reviewed past form of hide; AGID marks the inferred mapping uncertain. A rare bound-adjective use does not supply a common independent base sense.
exclude.SADES: Reviewed noun plural of sade; AGID marks POS uncertain, but this is an inflected form without a common independent base sense.

keep.ABODE: Independent noun meaning home/dwelling, not only past of abide.
keep.BOUND: Independent noun/verb meaning limit or leap, not only past of bind.
keep.CLEFT: Independent noun meaning fissure, not only an inflection of cleave.
keep.CLOVE: Independent spice noun, not only past of cleave.
keep.CORPS: Singular military unit as well as invariant plural; not merely plural of corp.
keep.DROVE: Independent noun for a herd/crowd, not only past of drive.
keep.FOUND: Independent base verb meaning establish, not only past of find.
keep.GENUS: Singular biological classification, despite AGID also listing a rare plural of genu.
keep.MEANS: Independent singular method/instrument sense: a means to an end; not only plural of mean.
keep.MIGHT: Independent noun meaning strength, not only modal past of may.
keep.MOPED: Independent vehicle noun, not only past of mope.
keep.OPERA: Independent singular musical drama, not merely Latin plural of opus.
keep.SMELT: Independent fish noun and metalworking base verb, not only past of smell.
keep.SPELT: Independent grain noun, not only past of spell.
keep.SPOKE: Independent wheel-part noun, not only past of speak.
keep.STOLE: Independent garment noun, not only past of steal.
keep.STOVE: Independent appliance noun, not only past of stave.
keep.WOUND: Independent injury noun/base verb, not only past of wind.
